create_MKDetector_univariate: create an MKDetector instance with univariate TimeSeriesData to detect monotonic trends using the Mann-Kendall test
run_MKDetector_detector: run the MKDetector detector method with a window_size and direction to find trend change points
run_MKDetector_multivariate: run the MKDetector with multivariate data to detect trends across multiple metrics simultaneously
plot_MKDetector_results: plot the detected trend change points on the original time series using the MKDetector plot method
get_top_k_metrics: get the top k metrics showing the most significant trend at a specific time point using get_top_k_metrics
